XMLDB.COMMENT: Catalogue pages: the record of searches that found nothing (AC-4.22.4), and the cards of the Why-choose-us section.

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_cat_searchlog
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per distinct search term that returned no course and no category. Aggregated on the folded key, so spelling variants of one word are one row. Carries no user column by design.

FIELD.NAME: termkey
FIELD.COMMENT: the term folded by text_util::normalise() - the aggregation key, never displayed

FIELD.NAME: term
FIELD.COMMENT: the term as first typed - what the report shows

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: interface language at the most recent miss

FIELD.NAME: hits
FIELD.COMMENT: how many times this term has been searched with no result

TABLE.NAME: local_nit_cat_whycard
TABLE.COMMENT: One card of the site-wide Why-thousands-choose-us section shown under the hero of every category page. Title and body hold {mlang en}..{mlang}{mlang ar}..{mlang} pairs; the optional picture lives in the whycard file area (system context, itemid = id).
